build_after_2026_06_05_reading: MEASURED (counts, dates and store labels only; no account value; the build file is r34/after/security_day_price.parquet, 2,124,908 rows, dates 2013-04-03 to 2026-10-06). (1) The build series has 71,374 rows dated after 2026-06-05, on 86 dates to 2026-10-06, across 1,319 CUSIP-keyed securities. (2) The minted tables hold account-days dated 2026-06-08 to 2026-06-22: minted account_day_value 4,836 rows dated after 2026-06-05 (of 21,102,041), and minted daily_returns 1,667 rows (of 1,691,729). Their price_source labels are the same store families the build carries for those dates (cottonwood-gold-canonical-holdings, cottonwood-silver-canonical-prices, cash-at-par, etfs-bbg-testpull-ticker-history). So the range 2026-06-06 to 2026-06-22 is in the served minted copy: true. (3) The minted tables end at 2026-06-22 (max date of both tables; month_grades reported_year_end max 2026-06-23). The build rows on 2026-09-04 (822 rows) and on 2026-10-02 (911 rows), where the one-day steps sit, lie after every minted date: no minted table reads them, so those steps are HELD (in the words of the CTO ruling 5). INFERRED, not measured: that the minted close equals the build price on the 2026-06-08 to 2026-06-22 rows; the link rests on the builder's inputs (commonwealth_fwd3_serve.py lines 7-9: after/account_day_value and after/security_day_price). Served paths beyond the minted tables were not traced for the build series (outside item 4).
headline: The minted tables are one S3 object per prefix (2026-10-09T12:41Z). In code, 2 consumers read them directly (the ARD adapter reads all three; the price-basis census reads account_day_value); 0 of 2 serve a page. The graph shows no portal-page reader of the minted prefixes, with a positive control that finds known consumers. A second hop exists in code: the ARD adapter output feeds gold account_return_daily, then the publish path, then the InvestorReporting dashboard page; that read route is recorded as planned, not applied, so liveness is not established. disarm_fact_a = consumers_found, so per CTO ruling 1 the correction is the next cell, not a disarm. Build rows dated 2026-06-06 to 2026-06-22 are in the served copy; the 2026-09-04 and 2026-10-02 steps feed no minted table (HELD). Nothing was built, served, written or corrected.
not_established: Whether any live route serves the minted prefixes: the portal search (portal, opal_ai, mcportal, 2,039 files) found no reader and the route config was not traced beyond that search.
Whether the ARD mint (CB-al-2) has written any Cottonwood gold account_return_daily partition: the S3 listing was limited to the three minted prefixes by the TO, so the gold prefix was not listed.

The second hop: commonwealth_account_return_daily.py emits gold account_return_daily; infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/reporting-publish/handler.py reads every gold partition and writes platinum/reporting/account=<id>/ series.json.gz and manifest.json; portal/src/pages/InvestorReporting/dashboard/seriesContract.ts reads those two documents. The lambda-source-map entry (infra/aws/lambda/ci/lambda-source-map.json:6485) records the read route as Planned, not applied. Whether the publish Lambda and the dashboard read are deployed was not measured.

data/assets/scripts/gold/irpt_custody/client_report_figures.py (IRPT_CUSTDY CU-a-2) reads gold account_return_daily for one client's quarter-end report; its liveness and any delivery to a person were not measured.

The graph (comp-platinum) has no producer or consumer edge for the minted keys (PRODUCER empty for all three prefixes, both the commonwealth/... and platinum/commonwealth/... forms). The builder addresses the tables through lib/opal_naming (address(), not a literal), so literal-key queries cannot see it. A zero from the graph is therefore a zero of the portal-platinum domain only.
The TO's named control (the cot price store key) returned no consumer; the record uses platinum/firm/client_directory.json instead, a sibling the graph does resolve.
The value-level link between the build price series and the minted close on 2026-06-08 to 2026-06-22 is INFERRED from builder inputs (see build_after_2026_06_05_reading); it is not measured here.
Other served paths that read the build series after 2026-06-05 (for example a cot canonical price store writer) were not traced: item 4 scope is the minted tables and their consumers.
